in-proof / merged / by-Śiva-step-shining-glory-force / body-breath-etc. / measured-made-knower-standing-formed / when / time-cadre / dissolution-step / reaches / your / then / goddess / who-this / shines / my / she / would-be / Śiva-made // kram-p25
l2: In proof merged, by Śiva-step-shining-glory-force — body-breath-made, measured-made-knower-standing-formed. When time's cadre reaches Your dissolution-step — then the goddess who shines, mine — she would be Śiva-made.
l3:
When proof has melted into Śiva-step-shining glory — body-breath measured into knower-standing —
when time's frame meets Your dissolving step — then she who shines, mine, would be Śiva-made.

sanskrit: prakāśākhyā saṃvit kramavirahitā śūnyapadato bahirlīnātyantam prasarati samācchādakatayā | tato 'py antaḥsāre galitarabhasād akramatayā mahākālī seyaṃ mama kalayatāṃ kālam akhilam
l1:
## kram-p26-v26 (26)
manifestation-named / consciousness / sequenceless / from-void-step / outside-merged / utterly / spreads / as-covering / then / too / in-inner-essence / melted-rush / sequencelessly / great-Time-goddess / she-this / my / making-time / time / all // kram-p26
l2: Manifestation-named consciousness, sequenceless, from void-step, outside-merged — spreads utterly as covering. Then too in inner-essence, by melted rush, sequencelessly — great Time-goddess, making all time.
l3:
Called manifestation, knowing — sequenceless, from void's step merged without —
spreading sheer as cover. Then within, rush melted, sequence-free: great Kālī, making all time, mine.

sanskrit: tato devyāṃ yasyāṃ paramaparipūrṇasthitijuṣi kramaṃ vicchidyāśu sthitimatirasāt saṃvidadhati | pramāṇaṃ mātāraṃ mitim atha samagraṃ jagad idaṃ sthitāṃ kroḍīkṛtya śrayatu mama cittaṃ citim imām

## kram-p27-v27 (27)
then / in-goddess / in-which / supreme-full-standing-enjoying / sequence / having-cut / quickly / standing-minded-taste / reflecting / proof / knower / measure / then / whole / world / this / standing / having-folded / may-resort / my / mind / consciousness / this // kram-p27
l2: Then in the goddess in whom supreme-full-standing-enjoying — sequence cut, quickly, standing-minded-taste reflecting — proof, knower, measure, then whole world this standing embraced — may my mind resort to this consciousness.
l3:
Then in her — supreme, full, standing, enjoying — cut sequence short,
quick, taste standing-mindedness: proof, knower, measure, world entire embraced — may my mind resort to this knowing.

sanskrit: anargalasvātmamaye maheśe tiṣṭhanti yasmin vibhuśaktayas tāḥ | taṃ śaktimantaṃ praṇamāmi devaṃ manthānasaṃjñaṃ jagadekasāram

## kram-p28-v28 (28)
unobstructed / in-self-made-Lord / in-great-Lord / abide / in-which / pervading-powers / those / that / power-possessor / I-venerate / god / churn-named / world-one-essence // kram-p28
l2: Unobstructed, in self-made Lord, in great Lord — abide, pervading powers. That power-possessor, I venerate — god, churn-named, world-one-essence.
l3:
Unhindered, in the self-made Lord, great Lord, wide powers abide;
that power-bearer I bow — god, churn-named, the world's one sap.

sanskrit: itthaṃ svaśaktikiraṇaughanutiprabandhān ākarṇya deva yadi me vrajasi prasādam | tenāśu sarvajanatāṃ nijaśāsanāṃśusaṃśāntitākhilatamaḥpaṭalāṃ vidheyāḥ

## kram-p29-v29 (29)
thus / own-power-ray-mass-praise-bonds / having-heard / O-god / if / my / you-go / to-grace / by-that / quickly / all-folk / by-own-rule-rays / pacified-all-darkness-masses / make-ye // kram-p29
l2: Thus own-power-ray-mass-praise-bonds heard — Lord, if You come to grace — by that quickly all folk, by own-rule-rays, darkness-masses allayed — make ye.
l3:
Thus — these praise-bonds of Your power's ray-mass heard — Lord, if grace comes —
quickly by Your rule-rays make all folk, darkness allayed.

sanskrit: ṣaṭṣaṣṭinām eke varṣe navamyām asite 'hani | mayā 'bhinavaguptena mārgaśīrṣe stutaḥ śivaḥ ||

## kram-p30-v30 (30)
sixty-sixth / named / in-year / on-ninth / on-dark / on-day / by-me / by-Abhinavagupta / in-Mārgaśīrṣa / praised / Śivaḥ // kram-p30
l2: In the sixty-sixth year, on the ninth dark day, in Mārgaśīrṣa, by me Abhinavagupta, Śiva was praised.
l3:
In the sixty-sixth year, ninth of the dark fortnight —
in Mārgaśīrṣa, by me, Abhinavagupta, was Śiva praised.
